summary: Standing rule: when a resume refuses because the manifest branch differs from the worktree/PR-head branch, the dispatch session corrects the manifest to the PR head using cli-dispatch write-manifest (after remove-verdict --from failed when the task sits in failed/); applies to AISDLC-840, AISDLC-846 and every later task of the same shape

options.description: Dispatch copies the failed manifest, sets branch to the PR head, adds a resume note, runs cli-dispatch write-manifest --json; remove-verdict --from failed first if refused. Added to the dispatch operational list.
Planner edits board files by hand (violates planner-delegates rule)
Park every mismatched task until a CLI exists
